Issue notice to the respondents, returnable on 14th June,

4. Having regard to these facts, liberty of the Applicant is protected till the prosecution is heard in the matter.
Hence, the 28.aba734.24.odt 1 of 2  following order:-
1 (i) Till the next date, in the event of arrest of applicant in connection with Crime No. 0025/2024,
registered with Jinsi Police Station, Dist. Aurangabad for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 273, 188 of IPC, 26(1), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(d), 27(3)(e), 30(2)
(a), 59 of Food Safety and Standard Act and 7(2) of the Cigarette and other Tobacco Products (Prohibition on Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, he shall be released on bail on furnishing PR Bond of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount.
(ii) He shall attend the concerned police station once in a week.
(iii) He shall not contact the witnesses directly or indirectly.
(iv) He shall not interfere with the evidence in any manner whatsoever.
(v) He is further directed to cooperate the investigating agency for further investigation.
(vi) Learned APP to communicate this order to concerned Police Station.

opennyai_summary.final__facts:
Applicant apprehends arrest in connection with Crime No. 25/2024 registered with Jinsi Police Station, Dist. Aurangabad for the offences punishable under Section 328, 273, 188 of IPC, 26(1),
26(2)
(iv), 27(3)(d), 27(3)(e), 30(2)(a), 59 of Food Safety and Standard Act and 7(2) of the Cigarette and other Tobacco Products (Prohibition on Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce,
Production, Supply and Distribution) Act.
opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
2. It is the contention of the learned counsel for the applicant that the name of the applicant does not appear in the first information report to be the person from whose custody the contraband articles are seized.
The solemn statement is made that he has no criminal history 904.aba734.24.odt 1 of 2 and he never involved in similar crime.
Learned APP opposed the application by contending that during the course of the investigation name of the applicant has revealed as supplier of the contraband articles and hence, he is not entitled for anticipatory bail.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
3. There is no dispute about the fact that the contraband articles seized at the spot were not from present applicant.
There is criminal history against him.
opennyai_summary.final__decision: Having regard to the said facts the liberty of the applicant deserves to be protected.
